name: Beneficial owner or controller cannot be identified
description: Ownership or governance is opaque and no natural person who owns or controls the entity can be identified after reasonable effort.
fp: Complex but legitimate ownership may need extra time or documents to resolve.

links.name: Beneficial owner cannot be identified
links.ctx: Ownership chain ends in an entity, trust or foundation with no natural person identified after reasonable effort.

links.name: Ownership or management opaque for cash business
links.ctx: Unclear beneficial owners, nominee directors or frequent ownership change in a cash business.

links.name: Opaque governance or controllers
links.ctx: Unclear trustees, control or beneficial owners.

links.name: Beneficial owner or controller cannot be identified
links.ctx: The person who really funds or controls the club or sponsoring company cannot be established after repeated enquiries, often after a quick succession of ownership changes.

links.ctx: Joint venture entity has partners or beneficial owners that cannot be verified.
